channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Major new £200,000 soft play area coming to leisure centre
item.description: Councillors are divided over the potential loss of the climbing wall at Fareham Leisure Centre.

item.title: Familiar faces at beloved Southampton pub whose future hangs in the balance
item.description: This pub and traveler’s rest was, for decades, best known as the ultimate match day pub due to its proximity to the Dell, the former home of Saints.

item.title: 'Characterful' Victorian home in Shirley up for sale for £400,000
item.description: A Victorian semi-detached home is up for sale in Southampton for £400,000.

item.title: People stopped to stare at Nazi bulletproof car
item.description: Parked near Stag Gates in the Avenue, the automobile attracted humans like a magnet.

item.title: Delays as 20-mile diversion introduced for works on less than half-mile stretch
item.description: Motorists are being warned of delays as a nearly 20 mile-long diversion route has been put in place for works on a less than half a mile stretch of road in Botley.

item.title: All options to be looked at after numerous illegal traveller camps set up last year
item.description: All options are being explored as leaders look to step up the response to unauthorised traveller encampments in Southampton.

item.title: Inquest opens after Dibden man found dead at computer shop
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of a man who was found dead at his workplace.

item.title: Father sells cattle to help daughter after riding accident leaves her in coma
item.description: A New Forest father is selling his cattle to help raise money for his teenage daughter after she suffered a serious brain injury in a horse-riding accident.

item.title: Mum fights to help daughter who was born 'without any blood'
item.description: A Gosport mother whose daughter needed resuscitation at birth is raising funds for specialist treatment and equipment to give her “a chance of a good life”.

item.title: Terrifying burglar chased man with crowbar after putting on victim's clothes
item.description: A man experienced a night of terror when a burglar broke into his Southampton home, put on his victim's clothes and chased him with a crowbar
